Then the torque based adaptive scheme is further derived with Lyapunov theorem and the limitation of the scheme is also exposed, due to that Lyapunov stability criterion is not always satisfied. Besides, it is revealed that the torque model is more applicable to heavy-load operation. Experimental results are given to verify the proposed analysis.

articleTitle: An optimal scheduling method for renewable energy system with pumped storage station
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The power grid with renewable energy as the main power can be called the renewable energy grid. In view of the fact that the uncertainty of the power generation in a renewable energy grid is very prominent, power grid dispatching control which takes the power balance as the primary task must adopt targeted response measures. Based on the operation mechanism of energy storage, a mathematic model of day-ahead scheduling and real-time scheduling with pumped storage power station is established from the view of the progressive connection between day-ahead scheduling and real-time scheduling. The reserve capacity for balancing fluctuating power is mainly borne by the conventional power supply, and the reserve for balancing uncertainty power is mainly borne by the pumped storage power station. The two types of the power supply are mutually complementary to realize the power balance of the grid. A wind power stability evaluation index is proposed in this paper to measure the system stability of different dispatching mechanism to compensate the unbalanced power. Finally, a simple case of renewable energy system with four elements is calculated, from which the relationship between the optimal dispatching mechanism and energy storage capacity is qualitatively discussed and shown.

articleTitle: The application of multifunctional structure in space transportation system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The demand for miniaturization and lightweight of the launch vehicle is becoming stronger and stronger, along with the vigorously development of industrial spaceflight. But it is limited to carry out the research of lightweight in two aspects of traditional rocket structure and equipment, it can't meet the development needs of the space transportation system. Multifunctional structure is the integration design of different functional units, such as structure, energy, electronic equipment and thermal control etc, and also is an effective way to develop the lightweight of the launch vehicle. In this paper, the application of multifunctional structure in space transportation system is studied, technical connotation and research status is introduced, a principle prototype of the multifunctional structure including structure, energy and information acquisition is completed, a preliminary exploration of the application of the multifunctional structure technology in space transportation system is realized.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic and mechanical analyses of less-rare-earth interior permanent-magnet synchronous machine used for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In recent years, as the price of rare-earth permanent magnet fluctuates dramatically, the less-rare-earth interior permanent-magnet synchronous machines (LRE- IPMSMs) used for electric vehicles (EVs) have received more and more attentions. LRE-IPMSMs combine the features of high power density in permanent-magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) and low cost in synchronous reluctance machine (SynRM), which are promising candidates for traction motors in EVs. This paper investigates the electromagnetic performances of a 70kW LRE-IPMSM with the rotor structure of two-layer flux barrier. As a narrow bridge width can provide more torque but impairs the machine mechanical strength, the stress distribution of LRE-IPMSMs is investigated. The effects of widening the bridge and radial rib on reducing maximum stress are analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Hierarchical energy storage configuration method for pure electric vehicle fast charging station
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Aiming at short-term high charging power, low load rate and other problems in the fast charging station for pure electric city buses, two kinds of energy storage (ES) configuration are considered. One is to configure distributed energy storage system (ESS) for each charging pile. Second is to configure centralized ESS for the entire charging station. The optimal configuration strategy of hierarchical ESS is studied based on some influencing factors such as basic capacity cost, electricity charge, cost of ESS, costs of the transformer and converter and energy loss costs caused by efficiency factors. Combining with the different characteristics of charging load timing of multiple charging piles, the economic comparison of the ES configuration schemes are carried out and the effects of the components in the total cost are analyzed based on the topology of the charging system in the station. With the measured data of a fast charging station for electric city buses in Beijing, a multi-level linear programming optimization method is adopted. With the target of the lowest comprehensive cost of the charging station, it is concluded that it is more economical to configure centralized ESS at the DC bus.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of DC micro-grid based on virtual motor control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A flexible DC micro-grid model is proposed, which is suitable for grid-connected renewable energy and energy storage. The complete circuit topology and its corresponding control strategy are given, which can make sure energy reliability, and can automatically achieve a reasonable power distribution. In addition, based on the theory of Virtual Generator (VG), a complete control strategy of each interface is proposed, that is, the Virtual DC Generator (VDG) control strategy is adopted in the load and energy storage unit, and the Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control strategy is adopted in the grid connection interface. VSG has the similar active and reactive power adjustment ability to the synchronous generator. The voltage amplitude and frequency of the grid- connected inverter are adjustable. It can simulate the inertia and damping characteristics of the synchronous generator, and overcome the impact of the traditional grid-connected inverter without inertia to the grid, which can effectively enhance the ability of the grid to accept renewable energy. What's more, the model of electric vehicles is considered into the micro-grid to meet the future trend of power grid. Simulation and experimental results verify the validity and reliability of the proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of an inductor magnetic lead screw
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper introduces an inductor magnetic lead screw (IMLS) for simplify the structure of magnetic lead screw (MLS). The IMLS is formed on the basis of reluctance MLS with toroidal windings on both sides of the screw. The windings are assigned by dc current of reserved direction to produce magnetic flux through the air gap. The degree of freedom of the nut and screw is limited to avoid the brush for windings. The topology and principle of IMLS are presented in this paper. The characteristic of thrust force are analyzed using two-dimensional (2-D) finite element method (FEM). The effect of rib width and groove depth on the magnetic fields distribution in air gap is studied for an optimized design.

articleTitle: Low - speed dynamic performance improvement strategy based on ADRC for sensorless IPMSM control system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper presents an active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) strategy based dynamic performance improvement scheme for position sensorless interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) drive. In traditional high- frequency injection based sensorless control, the digital filters and the inaccurate position tracking observer used in sensorless control deteriorate the dynamic property. For dynamic performance improvement, an improved ADRC strategy is proposed adopting ESO and NLEF control, which can estimate and compensate the nonlinear and uncertain disturbance. The proposed ADRC strategy based sensorless control scheme was evaluated on a sensorless IPMSM drive, and the experimental results confirm the expected dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Uncertainty and disturbance estimator based current control of LCL-Filtered grid-connected inverters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper proposes a new current control strategy for LCL-filtered grid-connected inverters based on the uncertainty and disturbance estimator (UDE). To ensure system stability, the LCL filter resonance is actively damped using the classical approach of feeding back the filter capacitor current giving rise to a combined active damping with UDE based control structure. The UDE based control method uses the known part of system model while the terms including unknown dynamics are treated as additional system uncertainties and disturbances, then appropriately estimated and canceled. The effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method are demonstrated through simulation results.

articleTitle: Study on a spoon shape magnetic core contactless transformer for the ICPT system in railway transportation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Contactless transformer is a key part of the inductive contactless power transfer (ICPT) system. In this paper, a contactless transformer is proposed with spoon shape magnetic cores. With 3D finite element methods (FEM), this paper calculates coupling coefficients of the transformer at different inner lateral side distances and end bending angles and extension lengths of the magnetic cores, obtains the magnetic field distribution and optimizes magnetic cores arrangement. The results show that the contactless transformer with spoon shape cores can improve coupling performance and power transmission efficiency of the ICPT system.

articleTitle: Recovery strategy and probability model for emergency control of thermostatically controlled load groups
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: As the typical load with thermal energy storage property, thermostatically controlled loads possess the potential to actively participate in load shedding control for power system. This paper takes air conditioning load as an example, proposing a recovery strategy for emergency control of thermostatically controlled load groups. Moreover, the emergency control strategy's probability model was established. Firstly, the single model and aggregation model of air conditioning loads were introduced respectively, basing on which the emergency control strategy was designed for thermostatically controlled loads. To avoid the aggregated power oscillations during load recovery process after load control, a recovery strategy was proposed. Then, The load control strategy's probability model was established to describe thermostatically controlled load groups' control characteristics. Lastly, the effectiveness of the proposed load group's recovery strategy and probability model were verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Residual flux suppression of protective current transformers for autoreclosure process
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: When a protective current transformer (CT) operates in a reclosing process, the core will contain a certain amount of residual flux, which cannot be significantly reduced during reclosure. If a later fault occurs after reclosing, the CT core will rapidly saturate, resulting in protection devices refusing to operate or mal-operating. Aiming at this problem, a fast CT demagnetization strategy under reclosing process is proposed in this paper. The proposed demagnetization strategy is achieved by a demagnetizing circuit connected to the CT secondary side, which can generates a time varying voltage to control the CT magnetic flux. Different from the traditional demagnetization method, the proposed demagnetization strategy can be used for the already in-service CTs. Finally, simulations are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method under the reclosing process, and from the results, the method can operate faster and more efficiently. Furthermore, the selection methods of DC voltage source and current-limiting resistance in demagnetizing circuit is introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: The research of nonlinear factor characteristics and control method on large inertia electromechanical actuator servo mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: For flight attitude control problem affected by nonlinear property of hypersonic vehicle, the influences of nonlinear factors which are driving space, stiffness, friction torque in the electric servo mechanism are analyzed in this paper, and the definition and generation conditions of limit cycle caused by the backlash are also discussed. For the problems of limit cycle oscillation and the airfoil intensified oscillation with large inertia caused by driving space, a system backlash limit cycle gap model and nonlinear vibration model are established, and the backlash compensator methods are proposed. This paper focuses on the influence of backlash, airfoil moment of inertia, servo stiffness and disturbing force to servo mechanism system. Based on increasing backlash compensator by controlling inner ring, the design method of accelerated negative feedback is introduced to the outer ring, solving “jitter” problem in large inertia system, and the simulation and experimental results demonstrate that this theory is correct.

articleTitle: Harmonic suppression strategy for voltage-controlled grid-connected inverter based on parameter optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The injected grid current of single-phase grid-connected inverter will be distorted when the grid voltage contain any low-order harmonics. Thus, an effective harmonic suppression method should be designed to reduce total harmonic distortion for injected grid current, a novel method of harmonic suppression is proposed to achieve a low THD. In this paper. Harmonic components of grid voltage is extracted by the fourth order band-pass filter separately and injected into the reference of inverter output voltage for compensation. The particle swarm optimization is used to optimize the parameters of double loop control and the fourth order band-pass filter for a better effect of harmonic suppression. Simulation and experimental results validate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Influence of electric vehicles on reliability of power system containing wind power
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Wind power has brought great fluctuation to the power system. The wide use of electric vehicles has exacerbated this challenge. Firstly, the mathematical model of electric vehicles under random charging mode was given. This paper analyzed the changes of the power system reliability when the proportion of electric vehicles increased, which shows the increase of electric vehicles under random charging mode poses a great threat to the reliability. Besides, a new concept of virtual combined load was put forward to research the fluctuant factors of power system. Based on vehicle-to-grid (V2G) technology, a charge and discharge control strategy of electric vehicles was proposed, simulation results show that the proposed strategy can achieve the purpose of moderate the fluctuation of virtual combined load. Finally, based on IEEE-RTS system, it was confirmed that the proposed strategy significantly improved the reliability of power system.

articleTitle: A current harmonics suppression method for permanent magnet synchronous motor drives
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A current harmonics suppression method for permanent magnet synchronous motor drives is presented in this paper. The harmonic model of permanent magnet synchronous motor is analyzed. According to this harmonic model, the harmonic current can be estimated. The harmonic suppression method using PI or P controllers is then demonstrated. With the presented method, the current harmonics in d- and q- axis can be suppressed independently and selectively. Experimental results show that the presented method can provide a good performance on harmonics suppression.

articleTitle: High switching frequency control scheme for dual- three-phase PMSM and simulation analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The switching frequency of power inverters among the traditional motor drive systems are almost between 4kHz to 20kHz. The appearance of SiC or GaN devices make it is possible to increase the switching frequency for improving the performance of power inverter. In this paper, a high switching frequency control scheme based on DSP and FPGA is proposed to drive a SiC power inverter. Multiphase motor drives such as dual- three phase permanent magnet synchronous motor have many advantages over the traditional three-phase motor drives. The scheme in this paper is based on the dual-three phase PMSM. The simulation results are presented to demonstrate the performance of this scheme.

articleTitle: Characteristics comparison of typical secondary-side compensation topologies in wireless powering systems with constant-current primary-side
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper compares the characteristics of serial, parallel and LCC compensation topologies of secondary-side in wireless powering systems with a constant-current primary-side. The topologies characteristics of power, efficiency and load are carefully analyzed and detailed presented. And the correctness of theoretical analysis is verified by simulations. This study results can guide the selection of compensation topology in practical application.

articleTitle: Fast fault location and isolation scheme for active distribution network with effectively earthed neutral
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A fast fault location and isolation scheme for active distribution network with effectively earthed neutral is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the generalized current phase-angle difference (GCPAD) of a zone is defined, and its fault feature is analyzed. Secondly, the fault zone determination method based on the GCPAD is proposed. Thirdly, on the basis of the proposed fault zone determination method, the whole fault location and isolation scheme are presented. Finally, the suggested scheme is verified in an active distribution network model by MATLAB/Simulink simulation, and the simulation results indicate that this scheme is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Beat-less control of electrolytic capacitor-less air conditioning motor drive system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: There is ripples in the DC bus voltage of the electrolytic capacitor-less air condition motor system because the film capacitor is not big enough to store plenty of energy, which will cause a motor voltage offset and go further causing beat phenomenon in the motor current and the torque. Firstly, the reason of the beat phenomenon in the current and the torque is analyzed mathematically. Furthermore, a novel beat-less control strategy is proposed, which is realized by moving the modulation wave of space vector pulse width modulation up or down. The proposed method realizes the modulation wave moving by the different value between the feedback and the reference currents, which can lead to an offset in the inverter output voltage that can be used to neutralize the offset mentioned above. At last, the proposed beat-less control strategy was validated through simulation by the MATLAB/Simulink and experiment on a 1.0kW IPMSM air condition drive system.

articleTitle: Application of Bayesian compressed sensing theory in single -phase-to-ground fault line selection of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In order to obtain accurate single-phase-to-ground zero-sequence current signal to improve the accuracy of fault line selection, a new data acquisition method-compressed sensing theory, was applied to single-phase-to- ground fault line selection of distribution network. A new method of fault line selection based on Bayesian compressed sensing theory was proposed. The method used compressed sampling method to sample zero-sequence current of each line from 1/4 cycle before the fault to 1/4 cycle after the fault, and then reconstructed the zero-sequence current signal accurately by reconstruction algorithm. EEMD method was used to decompose the reconstructed signal, and then the relative energy factor of each line was calculated. The faulty line was selected by comparing the relative energy factor of each line. The simulation results showed that the proposed method was not limited by sampling frequency and has high accuracy and reliability. This method was suitable for cable-line hybrid lines, pure cable lines and pure overhead lines.

articleTitle: Research on the predictive voltage control method for the distribution static compensator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: An optimal predictive voltage control based on the deadbeat control scheme is proposed in this paper, which can eliminate the error caused the control delay and can be implemented without transforming to dq rotating coordinate system. So this method can simplify the design process of the control system. Additionally, it simplifies the implementation of switching states based on the principle of space vector modulation (SVM), which results in a constant switching frequency control and a simplified the design of filter inductance. At last, the simulation mode based on Matlab/Simulink and the 50kVar experimental prototype were built, and the simulation and experimental results prove the validity and feasibility of the proposed predictive voltage control method.

articleTitle: Optimal design and electromagnetic analysis of yokeless and segmented armature machine based on finite-element method and genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In view of the complex and special structure of the yokeless and segmented armature machine (YASA), this paper presents optimal design of a 22kW YASA to increase the torque density and reduce the cogging torque. The initial design dimensions are proposed by sizing equation and the 3D finite- element analysis (FEA). Then, the parameters such as the outer diameter, ratio of inner and outer diameter, permanent magnet height, air-gap length are optimized by genetic algorithm (GA). By means of the 3D FEA, the electromagnetic performances of YASA are investigated. Finally, a prototype is manufactured and tested. The results confirm that the design and optimization are reliable.

articleTitle: Research on high power interleaved bidirectional dc/dc converter with coupling technique
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Interleaved dc/dc converter with coupled inductors is preferred in high power applications for their better steady- state and dynamic-state performances. But most of the coupled inductors proposed so far for multi-phase interleaved converters are in the same core, which may suffer several issues, such as asymmetrical parameters, high manufacturing cost and large dc flux. In this paper, the merits of 3-phase interleaved dc/dc converters with coupled inductors are analyzed theoretically, then an equivalent model is deduced in order to use standard transformers instead of the 3-phase coupled inductor. With standard transformers, the cost can be reduced, the parameters can be symmetrical and there will be nearly no dc flux. The proposed model is applied to a 3-phase interleaved dc/dc converter in PSIM to verify its superiority and practicability.

articleTitle: Research on stray current and rail-to-earth resistance in traction supply system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Compared by the stray current of the Chinese national industry standard CJJ 49-92, recommend national standard GB/T 28026.2-2011and EN 50122-2:2010 on basis of Chengdu metro line 3 test, some problems including the method of measuring the rail- to-earth resistance and the standard to evaluate the rail-to-earth resistance should be paid attention to during revising and publishing the stray current standards.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimal operation of CCHP system with PV/PT integrated module
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The technology of renewable energy has been raising public's concern and developing rapidly, however fossil fuels still seize the dominant position around the world. Therefore, how to gain the effective integration of renewable energy and traditional energy appears especially significant. In this paper, the refined model of the combined cooling heating and power systems considering the optimal cooperation of different components is proposed. Optimal operation of CCHP system equipped with PV/PT integrated module is discussed around three indexes in respects of economy, energy consumption and environment. As to the comprehensive consideration of three indexes, the method of analytic hierarchy process is adopted to determine the weight of above indexes according to the importance. In case study, the power utilization of household appliance is optimized and the influence of the main modules configuration on the performance of CCHP system in the real-time electricity price environment is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on photovoltaic energy storage system based on LADRC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: To improve the dynamic performance and the anti-disturbance capability of the photovoltaic energy storage system, a control strategy of the bidirectional DC-DC converter based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (LADRC) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the mathematical model of the bidirectional DC-DC converter is established. And then, the double closed-loop control strategy based on LADRC is designed. Finally, the simulation model is established in Matlab\Simulink. Simulations are conducted to verify the performance of the proposed controller and comparisons between the proposed controller and the traditional double loop PI controller are carried out. Simulation results show that the new controller is more robust and more adaptive. It has a better anti-disturbance capability and a higher dynamic performance than the traditional PI controller.

articleTitle: Resonance influence factors analysis of high-speed railway traction power supply system based on RT - LAB
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Pulse Width Modulation technology is widely used in China High-Speed Railway. The harmonic distribution caused by this technology is more extensive, the characteristic harmonics are more obvious, it increases the possibility of the network-train coupling resonance in the traction power supply system(TPSS). In this paper, the multi conductor chain network model of traction network is established based on the complex depth model and Carson theory, and the dynamic simulation model of train is established. According to the theoretical calculation, a simulation is built in Matlab to analysis the impedance characteristics of TPSS, the parameter sensitivity of autotransformer(AT) interval distance, equivalent inductance, power supply length and the harmonic amplification rule when the train arrive the end of the power supply interval. Finally, the real-time simulation of TPSS is carried out on the RT-lab, and it is proved that the analysis of the impedance characteristic has certain guiding significance to avoid the network-train coupling resonance.

articleTitle: Research on control strategies of soft start and grid connection for high power synchronous compensator fed by low-voltage LCI
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper describes the soft start and grid connection control strategies for high power synchronous compensator fed by low-voltage load-commutated inverters (LCI). In the start-up stage, field weakening method is used to make the motor start stably, and the back electromotive force (EMF) basically remain stable within the LCI withstand voltage at the same time. When the motor speed up to above the rated speed, a free-deceleration connection strategy is adopted to connect grid. The motor back EMF amplitude is changed through the adjustment of excitation current. When the motor is decelerated to the rated speed, the conditions for grid connection are judged. If the grid connection fails in this cycle, the motor will re-access the LCI and repeat the same steps until meets the requirements. The feasibility of the proposed strategy is validated by simulation.

articleTitle: Power electronic transformer with ZVS full-bridge phase-shift DC-DC converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper a full-bridge phase-shift DC-DC converter that has the function of realizing zero-voltage switching (ZVS) is adopted into power electronic transformer (PET), and the functions of every part employing proper control strategy in the PET are analyzed. The simulation results show that this converter can still realize soft-switching in PET and it is appropriate to work in high frequency state to reduce the size and improve the efficiency of the device. Besides, both input current and output voltage of PET are in good shape from the results of Fourier analysis, which proves that PET has the ability of dealing with power quality problems such as voltage fluctuation and grid side harmonic as well as realizing voltage level transformation and energy transfer.

articleTitle: Design of compact smart actuator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In the research of variant aircraft and small UAV, the actuator is considered to be smaller in size and compacter in structure. In this background, this paper designs a new type of compact smart actuator, the actuator integrates simple hydraulic pump, hydraulic pump plunger adopts two simple structure, Oil flow distribution is realized by suction and discharge of one-way valve. In order to reduce the volume of the actuator, the housing of the hydraulic pump is connected to the actuator housing. The control circuit of the actuator is designed, and the simulation model is built on the AMEsim simulation platform to verify the correctness of the design.

articleTitle: Research on active power control method of photovoltaic inverter based on passive theory under weak gric
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The high line impedance and load fluctuations of weak grid can easily lead to grid voltage fluctuations and other issues. In order to make the grid-connected PV inverter have strong robustness and improve the dynamic response speed, the active power control method of PV inverter based on passive theory is proposed. Firstly, the control strategy of the power outer loop is given, and the Euler-Lagrange model of the inverter is established. And then the passivity property of the inverter has been analyzed. Finally, the dynamic response performance of the Euler Lagrange control technology is analyzed for the change of grid impedance and the change of grid voltage. And compared with PI control, the simulation results show that the method used in this paper has strong robustness. And the simulation results show that the passive controller can be applied to the weak grid environment with large impedance and unstable voltage, and the transient performance and robustness is better than PI control.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristics research on single phase permanent magnet swing angle torque motor of high voltage vacuum circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In order to enhance the operation performance of middle-voltage vacuum circuit breaker, the single phase permanent magnet swing torque motor is presented according to the 40.5kV indoor vacuum circuit breaker. In the aspect of theoretical analysis, the motion characteristics and load characteristics of transmission system are studied and given the structure design and parameters of permanent magnet motor, as the electrical load, magnetic load, pole and air-gap and so on. The matching performance are designed and accomplished between the prototype and vacuum circuit breaker, which designed testing system. The current, angle and stroke characteristics of contact are researched under the rated operational voltage. The stroke of contact are analyzed under the different operating voltage and capacitance capacity, which studied the stability of motion properties for motor based on the same operating conditions in the opening and closing operation. The results show that the average opening speed is 2.68m/s, average closing speed is 2.09m/s, which satisfy with the operating requirements of circuit breaker. In the different operating voltage, the average closing or opening speed are increase with the voltage. In the different capacity, the average closing or opening speed are increase with the capacity. This provides a basis for the medium voltage vacuum circuit breaker, porcelain column and tank circuit breaker by employing the motor driving actuator.

articleTitle: Dynamic interaction estimation in multi-infeed system considering effects of hvdc control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: With more HVDC inverters are located in close proximity, the complicated interaction between each inverter is inevitable. Besides the electrical topology of AC grid connected with inverters, the regulators of DC systems also play a very important role during the dynamic procedure. The conventional index of MIIF presented by CIGRE lacks the consideration of dynamic control in HVDC systems. In this paper, the performance of traditional MIIF, when quantifying interaction, is evaluated. In the case of faults occurring in AC system, the effects of control in both rectifiers and inverters on the features of interaction are analyzed, whereby a better approach to estimate interaction index and meanwhile consider DC current variation due to control is proposed. Finally, a multi-infeed HVDC system modeled in PSACD/EMTDC is used to validate the proposed approach. The results demonstrate more reasonable accuracy.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of improved Y-source inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The improved Y-source inverter (YSI) not only inherits the advantages of YSI, such as a simple structure, high voltage gain and low operating stress, but also solves the problems that the input current is discontinuous and mitigates the interference resulting from the leakage inductance. In recent years, Y source impedance network has become the main research direction of many scholars. Up to now, steady state and DC characteristics of improved YSI have been investigated in numerous articles. However, modeling analysis for improved YSI is rarely presented. It should be noted that due to the effective role of system modeling in closed-loop controller design, the modeling of improved YSI is critical. In this paper, a small-signal model of improved YSI with LC filter based on state-space averaging method is established. The transfer functions in continuous conduction mode (CCM) are further analyzed. Finally, in order to demonstrate the effect of circuit parameter variations on the system stability of improved YSI, the placement of poles and zeros of transfer functions is analyzed.

articleTitle: Inverter coupling evaluation and decoupling method based on dynamic relative gain
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The output active power and reactive power of new energy inverter can be controlled independently using vector control, but there are degrees of coupling between them under the influence of transmission line parameters. In this setting, an overall evaluation of the coupling degree of power is vital to achieve decoupling control. This paper indicates the root cause of inverter power coupling and necessity of decoupling them. Here a quantitative method to evaluate inverter power coupling degree in full frequency-domain is proposed by applying dynamic relative gain method. The new scheme is different from traditional relative gain method, which can evaluate power coupling degree completely and accurately. Advantage of this evaluation scheme is established through a case study. Droop control scheme obtained from calculating result are shown to be consistent with that derived analytically. A power decoupling control method based on diagonal matrix is then applied to eliminate the coupling. Finally, a model is designed in MATLAB/SIMULINK. Results for both island mode and parallel mode show good decoupling performance.

articleTitle: Research on state feedback of two-mass system based on weight coefficient
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: There is a general phenomenon of dynamic disturbances caused by the mechanical resonance caused by the elasticity of the connecting device and the change of the load in the common electric traction mechanism such as rolling mill and robot joint. Aiming at this problem, the two - mass modeling of the rolling mill and other transmission equipment is carried out, and the related mechanism is analyzed. A combination of the fractional - order perturbation observer and the state observer is proposed to make the system have better performance to suppress the dynamic change. On this basis, the weight coefficient is introduced on the positive and negative feedback loop to solve the contradiction between the two constraints. It aims to improve the servo system response performance by adjusting the weight coefficient. In this paper, the resonant suppression function and anti - jamming capability of different weight coefficients are verified.

articleTitle: A new DC-ice-melting device based on hybrid MMC structure
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, a new DC ice-melting scheme based on hybrid modular multilevel converter (MMC) is proposed considering the problems of existing DC ice-melting device, such as high harmonic content, complicated mode switching operation, large size and so on. In the scheme, a novel structure of MMC is composed of the upper bridge arm all using full bridge sub-module (FBSM) and the lower bridge arm all using half bridge sub-module (HBSM). In normal operation, the device implement reactive power compensation as static synchronous compensation (STATCOM), and under the condition of grid icing, the device can output continuous controllable DC voltage and current ranging from 0 to the set value for grid ice-melting. In this way, the economic benefits can be improved effectively. The outstanding advantages of the device based on MMC are described, and analysis of mathematical model and power to the structure is presented in this paper. A corresponding hierarchical control strategy is put forward, then feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme and control strategy are verified by simulation in PSCAD/EMTDC.

Author Keywords: Mixed Half Bridge and Full Bridge SM

articleTitle: A method of voltage detection specific to single-phase dynamic voltage restorer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A method of voltage detection specific to single-phase dynamic voltage restorer based on double closed-loops of proportional-resonant controllers is proposed for the fundamental wave extraction. The circuit topology and control strategy of dynamic voltage restorer are established to provide the basics for the design of voltage detection. To ensure the dynamic voltage compensation performance of digital control, analyze the discretization of proportional-resonant controller and filters. Focus on the improved method of extracting fundamental voltage and develop a 10 kW prototype. Based on the experiments of the prototype, the results prove that this strategy is easy to implement and has a good performance on voltage detection and compensation.

articleTitle: An improved forbidden-region-based criterion of vehicle-grid system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, an improved stability criterion based on the forbidden region is proposed for analysis of the low-frequency oscillation (LFO) arising in the electric railway system when multiple AC-DC-AC drive locomotives get charged at the same power supply section simultaneously. This criterion is simple to calculate and has low conservation. The LFO was successfully reproduced by establishing the time-domain simulation model in MATLAB/Simulink. Then the influence of gird-side parameters, traction-side parameters and converter control parameters in CRH5 on the LFO of vehicle-grid (V2G) system is discussed through simulation. Finally, the validity of the proposed criterion was verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Flux-weakening control using anti-windup for induction motor in constant-voltage region
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper presents a robust and relatively concise flux-weakening control scheme using anti-windup for induction motor(IM) in high speed region. The proper q-axis current reference in constant-voltage region is achieved for both maximum torque capability and anti-windup phenomenon. Comparing with voltage regulator method, only one tuning parameter ensures the tuning simplification. First, the operation constrains of IM in full-speed operating conditions are introduced. Then, this paper investigates the comparatively complex realization of flux-weakening close-loop with voltage regulator. Per the above, an effective algorithm using anti-windup for d-axis voltage control in constant-voltage region is proposed, which is confirmed the validity by the simulation results in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Control system design for dynamic road load simulators
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The dynamic road load simulator (DRLS), which is used to simulate the load torque of vehicle drivetrains, is an important equipment to test the reliability of vehicle drivetrains. In order to ensure its performance, this paper designs the control system for DRLS. The permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is used as the loading motor, and the control system applies the current, speed and load torque triple-loop structure. The speed controller is designed to suppress the resonant characteristic of DRLS, improving its dynamic performance. Since DRLS simulates the load torque according to the load spectrum, the load torque controller is designed based on the proportional resonant (PR) control, which can track periodic reference with zero steady-state error. Experimental results on DRLS are provided and validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The influence analysis of parameters mismatch in the input series output parallel system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, an output current differential control method is presented for an input series output parallel (ISOP) system. The method includes a specialized output current sharing loop to achieve power equilibrium in modules, and avoids steady- state sharing errors due to parameters mismatch. However, in the transient process, inconsistent parameters can produce individual input voltage and output current overshoots that have the potential to damage devices. This study analyses the effects of parameters mismatch on the dynamic characteristics of the system, and the voltage and current overshoots of modules are calculated. The results will help in device selection. The analysis method can also be applied to other control methods. Simulated and experimental waveforms of a 300-W prototype verified the analysis results.

articleTitle: WPT charging system for lithium battery based on PNGV model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, a kind of multi-stage WPT charging system of lithium ion battery based on the PNGV model is proposed after the analysis of lithium ion battery equivalent circuit model and existing charging method. Considering the charging quality of the lithium ion battery and prolonging the battery life, the system in the paper can effectively increase the charging speed and suppress the polarization reaction and temperature rising, which makes the actual charging curve closer to the best charging curve. The Matlab-Simplorer-Maxwell multi- platform is combined effectively, and the effectiveness of the scheme is verified by the joint simulation. The results have theoretical and practical value for the establishment of the WPT charging system platform for lithium ion batteries.

articleTitle: Investigation of a novel linear permanent magnet vernier motor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Currently, the linear motor has replaced the transmission mechanism composed of a rotary motor and a screw, and is widely used in direct drive applications such as computer numerical control (CNC) machine tools. As the thrust density of traditional linear permanent magnet synchronous motor is difficult to be further improved, linear permanent magnet vernier motors (LPMVM) based on magnetic field modulation principle are proposed to improve the thrust density further. A novel LPMVM is proposed in this paper. The topology and operation principle of the proposed LPMVM are introduced. The thrust density of the proposed LPMVM is improved significantly with a simple structure. The end force is analyzed and optimized to decrease the detent force further.

articleTitle: A single-phase five-branch modular multilevel converter for direct AC/AC equal frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: For medium- to high-voltage, high-power direct AC/AC conversion, modular multilevel converter (MMC) is a potential solution due to its outstanding features. However, MMC suffers from branch energy instability when frequencies of input and output are equal. This paper presents a single-phase five- branch MMC which is capable of direct AC/AC equal frequency conversion without branch energy stability problem. The branch energy stability criterion is described. A branch energy balancing strategy is proposed to achieve stable operation of the single-phase five-branch MMC. The proposed MMC and the control strategy are validated by MATLAB/Simulink simulations.

articleTitle: Research on new type electric variable transmission and its application in hybrid electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A new electric variable transmission in hybrid electric vehicle is analyzed. The equivalent magnetic circuit and finite element simulation model is established in this paper for analysis of internal magnetic field coupling law. As for the strong coupling relation in the internal magnetic field of electrical transmission, magnetic flux-insulation ring is the electrical the applied into the electric variable transmission in hybrid electric vehicle, and its mathematical model is also built. Then, the working modes of hybrid electric vehicle are analyzed. Power output of engine and electric variable transmission is depended on the power follower strategy. At last, the simulations and experiments have verified that the electric variable transmission can be used in hybrid electric vehicle, thus exploring a new way for the study of hybrid electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Robustness of servo drive system under position control mode based on sliding mode controller
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In various control strategies of servo drive system, PI controllers are still used due to their simplicity and ease of design. Unfortunately, PID controllers are not robust and their performance is deteriorated when the operating conditions change due to parameter variations of the motor. A position control method of servo motor based on sliding mode controller (SMC) is proposed in this paper, for improving the robustness, realizing precision positioning, and reducing the steady-state speed error of servo motor. Meanwhile, the SMC relieves low speed crawling phenomenon effectively for servo drive system. The experimental results indicate that robustness of the servo system has been improved significantly, and the dynamic and static performance is better under SMC when motor parameter mismatch. Moreover, low speed crawling phenomenon is also restrained, the method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Collaborative optimization of energy management strategy and sizing for the hybrid storage system of tram
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Energy management strategy and sizing are the key steps of the design of tram's power system and the result has a direct influence on operation characteristics and economic benefit. This paper subscribes an energy management strategy with dynamic power proportion, and makes a collaborative multi-objective optimization of dynamic power proportions and sizing based on the requirement of tram and line data using an improved Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm (PSO). The optimization decreases system weight and cost and prolongs the lifespan of battery.

articleTitle: A novel DC-DC converter with high step-down/high step-up voltage gain
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Based on the conventional buck converter and the switched network, this study presents a new DC-DC buck-boost converter. The proposed buck-boost converter can realize high step-down gain when the duty cycle D is smaller than 0.414 and high step-up gain when D ranges from 0.414 to 0.5. Meanwhile, the proposed converter possesses continuous output current which makes the output filter unnecessary. Continuous and discontinuous conduction mode analyses are detailed presented. Finally, some SIMetrix simulations are implemented to verify the proposed buck-boost converter's effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Study on line protection for distribution network based on current limiting characteristics of IIDG
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The shortage of energy and the deterioration of the environment have become increasingly prominent. A large number of distributed generation access to distribution network, network structure changes. Because of the fast response characteristic of the inverter interfaced distribution generation (IIDG), the instantaneous current protection of distribution network appears to be wrong or refused to move. In this paper, based on the research on the limit current of IIDG, the longitudinal protection scheme based on the amplitude comparison method is studied. In order to adapting to the fault of the transition resistance, protection scheme joins the negative sequence of the discriminant, Constituting a comprehensive range of discriminant protection scheme. In the PSCAD simulation of different fault types, different transition resistances and limit distribution network distance protection action, the protection can be the correct action, indicating the protection of adaptability.

articleTitle: Locomotives harmonic compensation by SiC auxiliary converter with active filter function
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper presents a method of active filter applied to auxiliary four- quadrant converter of electric locomotive or high speed train. In this technique, auxiliary power supply system is designed to generate an inverse harmonic current at AC side to produce the high frequency compensating current. So the auxiliary four- quadrant converter should operate at a high speed with the application of SiC devices. The results and effectiveness of the scheme is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Virtual capacitor based DBVC and active damping method for cascaded power converters stabilization control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: It is known that the constant power load (CPL) property of load converter can degrade the stability of DC bus voltage of cascaded power converters system. An idea by combining virtual capacitor (VC) based active damping control (ADC) method with DC bus voltage conditioner (DBVC) technique for load converter is proposed in this paper. Through implementing common virtual capacitance volume requirement, the DC bus voltage can be stabilized with reduced DC bus capacitor, the impact from DC bus voltage fluctuation to the load converter output voltage can be reduced compared with the case by using ADC method only, and because the VC method shares part of the compensation, the power volume of DBVC can be decreased accordingly, this might result in higher power density and lower power loss potentially compared to the case with DBVC only. Simulation results are provided to demonstrate the validation of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the parameter matching and CVT's target speed ratio optimization of plug in hybrid electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper focuses on the parameter matching and CVT's target speed ratio optimization for plug in hybrid electric vehicle. After matching the engine's parameters, ISG motor's parameters, the battery's parameters and the speed ratio of the final drive, the target speed ratio of CVT is optimized through the instantaneous optimization algorithm. Finally, the rule based control strategy is built, and the vehicle's power performance and economy of energy consumption is simulated basing on MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results show that the parameters matching of the powertrain system's components meets the design requirements of the power performance, and the optimized target speed ratio of CVT significantly improves the vehicle's economy of energy consumption, compared with the original CVT target speed ratio.

articleTitle: An improved LMMSE channel estimation algorithm for OFDM-based low voltage power line
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) technology is the preferred technique for low voltage power line communication because it can combat the frequency selective fading caused by multi-path transmission effectively. And channel estimation is one of the crucial domains of OFDM. In this paper, an improved Linear Minimum Mean Square Error (LMMSE) method is proposed which chooses the fist L taps as the channel energy and consider the rest N-L taps as the noise variance. From the simulation results of the BER and MSE performance, it can be concluded that the proposed method decreases the compute complexity but does not sacrifice the basic performance.

articleTitle: Control of hybrid locomotive based on two-level traction inverter of asynchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: As one of the distributed power sources, fuel cell is one of the most green energy sources. The power generation system has become the focus of the research, which has been used in many fields. According to the real running characteristics of the hybrid locomotive, the hybrid locomotive system consists of 150 kW proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) power generation system, DC/DC converter, battery energy store system, three-phase asynchronous traction motor, energy management system and other interconnections. As the model contains the three-phase asynchronous traction motor module to regulate the speed and torque, which makes the whole hybrid locomotive with two-level traction inverter of asynchronous motor system respond in real time and accurately.

articleTitle: PQ-U control method of grid-connected PV inverter under weak grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Under the condition of low short circuit capacity and high grid impedance of weak grid, the grid voltage is easily fluctuated due to the load change, affecting the power quality of the grid. In view of this problem, firstly, this paper analyzes the principle of the grid-connected voltage change caused by the load change. Secondly, an improved voltage-power control method (PQ-U) for three-phase grid-connected PV inverter is proposed. This method changes the output reactive power of PV inverter to maintain the stability of the bus voltage when the inductive or capacitive load changes significantly. Besides, the advantages of PQ-U control method relative to traditional PQ control method are compared and analyzed by Matlab software. The simulation results show that PQ-U control method can maintain the stability of bus voltage in inductive or capacitive load significant change and play a supporting role for weak grid voltage. Finally, experiments are done to verify the validity of the PQ-U control method.

articleTitle: Frequency response control strategy of air conditioning loads
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Air conditioning loads have the potential to participate in frequency response when the power shortage accident occurs. In this paper, a decentralized frequency response control strategy is proposed to take advantage of the potential of air condition loads. Firstly, we analyze the existing decentralized control strategy, which adjusts the setting temperature of air conditioners according to the frequency deviation. And the mechanism of the phenomenon in the existing control, which is the aggregate power oscillation in the control duration and the secondary pulse in the load recovery, is determined. Secondly, a decentralized self-discipline frequency response control strategy is proposed on this basis. Each air conditioner adjusts its upper and lower bounds of setting temperature in a self-discipline manner to hold the operating condition of air conditioning loads and avoid the power oscillation. The secondary pulse is eliminated by dayparting recovery. Finally, we analyze the control characteristic of the proposed strategy and the principle of the parameter choice in depth. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of IPMSM based on stress calculation of iron core
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The centrifugal force of rotor and motor interference assembly are the two most important sources of core stress in permanent magnet motor, thus the electromagnetic characteristics of permanent magnet motor are changed by core stress, which causes the error between calculation and the actual value of permanent magnet motor performance. In this essay, the stress equations of rotor centrifuge and stator interference assembly are studied, and the simulation method of permanent magnet motor considering the stress and magnetic properties of stator and rotor core is put forward. Taking an IPMSM as a prototype, the performance and parameters of the motor under the influence of considering stress or not are simulated and compared. The experimental results are compared with the simulation results, and the validity and accuracy of the method are verified.

articleTitle: Model predictive control method to reduce common-mode voltage for permanent-magnet synchronous machine drives
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: All the eight voltage vectors of a two-level voltage source inverter are treated as candidate voltages applied to the cost function in the conventional model predictive control (MPC) in order to minimize the error between reference and practical stator current. Due to the usage of zero vector voltage, there are large common-mode voltage (CMV) which will deteriorates the operation performance and reliability of the drive system. A MPC- based CMV reduction method was presented to reduce the peak value of the CMV at the expense of large current ripple. Then, a two-vector-based MPC method utilizing two selected nonzero voltage vectors at every sampling period was presented to achieve satisfactory current ripple performance, while it significantly increased the computational burden and system complexity. This paper investigate the CMV for permanent magnet synchronous machine drives and proposes a novel two-vector-based MPC scheme to reduce the CMV without deterioration in the current ripple performance. Furthermore, a simple and efficient duty ratio determination method of the two selected vectors is designed in order to avoid significantly increasing the computational burden. The simulation results will be presented to confirm that the proposed method can limit the CMV with ± V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dc</sub>/6 while preserving the low current ripple performance and fast dynamic response of the conventional MPC method.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of wind power generation system based on four-port electromechanical converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Wind power generation system based on four-port electromechanical converter (FPEC) is a new wind power system, which overcomes the shortcomings of many traditional wind power generation systems. According to its working mode and operating characteristics, this paper proposes an improved system control strategy as well as the concrete realization method based on fuzzy logic, which improves the energy management of wind power generation system. After the detailed theoretical analysis, this paper builds out the simulation model of fuzzy controller of the wind power generation system based on FPEC in MATLAB, describing the wind power generation system control based on fuzzy logic. The fuzzy controller has enhanced the robustness and flexibility of the wind power control system, and it lay the foundations for the development of this new wind power system.

articleTitle: A comparative study of three electrochemical battery models with different operating conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The design of a physics-based reduce-order battery model is especially desired by the automotive researchers and engineers due to the demand of battery system diagnosis and prognostics. Taking the problem into account, three physics- based electrochemical models include Pseudo two dimensional (P2D) model, extended single particle (ESP) model, single particle (SP) model are analyzed in this paper. The internal overpotential components are analyzed under six operating conditions. Results show that the SP model is appropriate for close-to-equilibrium OCV test condition; the ESP model is appropriate for slow charging, typical charging and driving cycle operating conditions; the P2D model is suitable for high C-rate constant current or pulse current discharge conditions. The analysis result method and result is meaningful for model order reduction.

articleTitle: Energy balance scheme for modularization of battery and DC/DC converter in parallel
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Individual difference of parallel batteries can cause battery overcharging or over-discharging. More seriously, single battery failure can result in system fault. An energy balancing strategy for battery stage of charge (SOC) balance and DC-DC converter output current sharing is proposed. In addition, the system is designed to cut off the module immediately once any cell fails. This strategy can extend batteries life effectively and enhance the system redundancy. Furthermore, two controllers are designed, one controller regulates the duty ratio of DC-DC converter to make the batteries SOC balanced when the SOC of cell is different, another controller is responsible for output current sharing after SOC balance. The simulation and experiment verification results show the effectiveness of the strategy.

articleTitle: Modular multilevel converter based bus bar in flexible substation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper proposes a new Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) based bus bar. Compared with the traditional bus bar, it can not only realize power control and reactive power compensation, but also prevent voltage drop and allow DC access, so it is very suitable for future flexible substation application. The structure which is composed of two back to back MMC is given. The power analysis and double closed-loop control method are proposed. Compared with other control methods, it adopts the arm current direct control which can remove the need for a circulating current suppressing controller. Simulation results verify the feasibility and correctness of the MMC based bus bar.

articleTitle: Research of transient process on three-phase four-leg inverter with unbalanced load
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: For three-phase four-leg inverter, symmetrical component method and double closed-loop control is a traditional method to sustain the symmetry of three-phase output voltage in steady-state under unbalanced load, but asymmetrical output voltage is still generated in transient process. By analyzing the transient process after sudden load change, this paper illustrates the change law of the output voltage in the transient process after sudden load change and use dynamic feedforward compensation to restrain the load current disturbance, which greatly improves the symmetry of transient output voltage. In the end, simulation is made in Matlab/simulink platform and the simulation result proves the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the mentioning method.

articleTitle: Analysis of eddy-current effects on one bearingless switched reluctance motor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A switched reluctance bearingless motor (SRBM) with single layer windings is presented. Particular effects of eddy currents on iron losses, torque and radial forces are analysed. A new principle to explain distribution of magnetic flux in motor sheet caused by eddy currents of frequencies from 3 000 Hz to 90 000 Hz is introduced. Iron losses, torque and radial forces are new estimated and calculated considering effects of eddy currents. The paper provides an overview of interdisciplinary research for eddy current effects on high-speed motors. Some valuable conclusion can be achieved from the results to better design a bearingless motor, especially its cooling system.

articleTitle: Control-oriented temperature dynamic modeling of open-cathode PEM fuel cell via on-line T-S fuzzy identification method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Temperature control has received widely attention in open-cathode PEM fuel cell system, due to the importance of stack temperature to the output performance of the stack. The open-cathode PEM fuel cell is such a nonlinear, time varying and uncertain system which increases the difficulty of establishing a control-oriented mechanistic model. In this paper, the on-line T-S fuzzy identification method is chosen to identify the open-cathode PEM fuel cell temperature dynamic model. The on-line T-S fuzzy identification method has the advantages of low computational cost and less requirements of the model parameters. It becomes one of the most promising methods to identify the system dynamic model. To appraise the applicability, efficiency, and robustness of the proposed on-line identification method, a real open-cathode PEM fuel cell platform was set up. Experimental results show that the established on-line T-S fuzzy identification model is sufficiently accurate to follow the temperature response of the stack, and can be easily utilized to model-based temperature control system design.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of speed loop control technology for permanent magnet synchronous motor servo system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Speed control loop is the intermediate link of the three control loops in the position servo system. The control method and technology of the speed control loop play an important role in the response of the whole system. This paper is based on the analysis of working principle of the permanent magnet synchronous motor, the principle of space vector control and the average equivalent principle of SVPWM algorithm. For the purpose of improving the speed control loop, precise PI control and angular position control are used to make permanent magnet synchronous motor operation characteristics excellent, though system modeling and simulation, system control parameter optimization.

articleTitle: Working progress analysis and parameter calculation of SEPIC in discontinuous conduction mode
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The output voltage of SEPIC can be greater, less or equal to its input voltage, and respond more gracefully to short- circuit output. Working process of SEPIC working in discontinuous conduction mode (DCM) was analyzed in detail. The parameter calculation method of SEPIC is also given. The relationship between duty ratio and output voltage of SEPIC working in continuous conduction mode (CCM) and DCM is presented, and the derivation process while SEPIC works in DCM is given in detail. Simulation model based on PSIM is built to verify correctness and feasibility. The simulation results of SEPIC in CCM and DCM was given which verifies the correctness and feasibility of scheme.

articleTitle: Toward a characteristic optimal power flow model for temporal constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: While the regular optimal power flow model focuses on a single time scan, the optimization of power systems is typically intended for a time duration with respect to a desired objective function. In this paper, a temporal optimal power flow model for a time period is proposed. To reduce the computation burden needed for calculating temporal optimal power flow, a characteristic optimal power flow model is proposed, which employs different characteristic load patterns to represent the objective function and security constraints. Both the temporal optimal power flow model and characteristic optimal power flow model can improve the systems' desired objective function for the entire time period. Numerical studies are conducted on the IEEE 14 and 118-bus test systems to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed characteristic optimal power flow model.

articleTitle: Assessment of up and down spinning reserve considering transmission constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper a new model is proposed to schedule the capacity of both up and down spinning reserve (SR) considering transmission constraints. Up SR is seen as the most important resource to cope with many contingencies and it is well studied, while the down SR is ignored by many papers especially when network constraints are considered. Ignoring the down SR would cause sub-optimal or even unfeasible solution. In this paper an iterative process is proposed to schedule up and down SR and the importance of down SR will be analyzed and illustrated. At each iteration of the process, the up SR cost is firstly minimized with respect to reserve constraints and reliability constraints and then the sum of expected interruption cost and down SR cost is minimized with respect to various post- contingency constraints under each contingency event to alleviate transmission congestion. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by the Roy Billinton Test System (RBTS) and the results are analyzed to illustrate the significance of down SR in the market-clearing model with transmission constraints.

articleTitle: A novel large current rectifier based on six windings isolated transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In order to enlarge the output current of the rectifier, a large current rectifier based on six windings isolated transformer is proposed. The proposed rectifier uses the six windings isolated transformer as the phase-shift transformer, and the primary windings of the transformer are connected in delta, the secondary windings are independent and provide three groups of single-phase voltage with 120°phase shifting in turn to feed three single-phase rectifiers. The three windings of the inter-phase reactor (IPR) are connected with the output positive electrodes of the three single-phase rectifiers, respectively. According to the structure of the isolated transformer, the input line current and load voltage of the large current rectifier are analyzed in theory, and the configuration parameters of the IPR are also calculated, related experiments are carried out. Theoretical analysis, simulating and experimental results demonstrate that the power quality on the input side and load side of the large current rectifier is similar to the traditional dual inverse-star rectifier, and the output current is 1.5 times of the dual inverse-star rectifier. In addition, the kVA rating of the isolated transformer is smaller than that of the transformer in the dual inverse-star rectifier, which can improve the power density of the proposed rectifier to some degree.

articleTitle: Research on reactive power characteristics of CCC inverter and its improved control strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper based on the commutation mechanism of series capacitor commutated converter (CCC), the CCC is applied to UHVDC transmission system, and the mathematical model of reactive power demand of CCC inverter is established. According to the actual parameters of Jiuquan-Hunan ±800 kV UHVDC transmission project, the simulation model of CCC- UHVDC system is built by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation software. Beside, combination of the changing characteristics of the DC current and the relationship between the electrical variations during the system failure, a method of parameter optimization especially for VDCOL input voltage is proposed, thus suppressed the DC peak current and improved the performance of reactive power characteristics, finally implement the control method by means of simulation software. Simulation results shows that CCC has the stronger ability to resist commutation failure. It also validates the effectiveness of the proposed parameter optimization method.
